'''Beatrix''' is an NPC that appears in [[Ragunna]], [[Rinascita]]. 

From 8.00 AM - 11:59 AM and 1:00 PM - 4:59 PM, she can be found talking with [[Nevana]] in the middle of [[Bank Street]].

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(at 8:00 AM - 11:59 AM)
:'''Beatrix:''' I'm so tired. My eyes can barely stay open...
:'''Beatrix:''' 6681, 6682...
----
;(at 1:00 PM - 4:59 PM)
:'''Beatrix:''' Phew... I've been busy all morning, and I still have to keep counting this afternoon. I need to pull myself together...
:'''Nevana:''' Two decaf Margheritas, a courtesy from Ms. [[Zani]].
:'''Beatrix:''' Tell Ms. Zani I said thank you.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(at 8:00 AM - 11:59 AM)
:'''Nevana:''' What are you counting?
:'''Beatrix:''' That bastard Barbosa made me count every old Monnaie sent to the vault.
:'''Nevana:''' The more incompetent the boss, the more fragile their ego. I warned you not to go against him. He'll just make an example out of you.
:'''Nevana:''' People in high positions care the most about saving faces. Show them attitudes, you only get a taste of your own medicine.
:'''Nevana:''' But I do agree with you on one thing.
:'''Beatrix:''' What's that?
:'''Nevana:''' He's a bastard.
----
;(at 1:00 PM - 4:59 PM)
:'''Beatrix:''' Look, the empty coffee cups on my desk are stacked to the ceiling.
:'''Beatrix:''' I swear, once I've downed my one-thousandth cup, I'm going to turn these empty cups into a piece of installation art!
:'''Beatrix:''' I'll write a resignation letter and put it through paper shredder—
:'''Beatrix:''' stuff the shredded pieces into every coffee cup and fill Mr. Barbosa's office with them.
:'''Beatrix:''' I've even thought of a name for this installation—it'll be absolutely sensational.
:'''Nevana:''' What's the title? Let me hear it.
:'''Beatrix:''' Sip and Split.
{{Dialogue End}}
